parent_objective: design the first fair multi-profile comparison pilot after all generated profiles pass train-loop smoke
blocked_by: Stage B proves train-loop plumbing but not fair comparison readiness or profile superiority
supersedes: using one-seed smoke diagnostics as a profile comparison
invalidates: claiming finite-window or GRU advantage from M1197 smoke metrics

public_gates: M1198 may design a fair comparison pilot only
M1198 must not train controller weights
M1198 must not run candidate replay
M1198 must not use private holdout
M1198 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
M1198 must not claim profile superiority
forbidden_shortcuts: do not reuse smoke metrics as comparison evidence
do not tune per profile from M1196 or M1197 results
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim paper-level evidence from a design document

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers the first fair multi-seed comparison pilot after all generated profiles complete train-loop smoke
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training replay PPO promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief profile-superiority or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if pilot would compare profiles with unequal seeds budgets env distributions or evaluation rules
stop if it relies on private holdout
stop if it would tune profile-specific hyperparameters from smoke results
stop if it does not separate plumbing evidence from comparison evidence
fallback_plan: if full profile pilot is too costly, design a public pilot over L0 L1 L2_window_25 L3 first
if recurrent profiles need reset semantics before comparison, route to reset-control design repair
if smoke metrics show a likely issue, route to focused training stability audit before comparison
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1197 all generated profiles pass smoke training and comparison must be pre-registered before any performance claim

admission_evidence: M1196 representative Stage A training smoke passes
M1197 all-profile Stage B training smoke passes
blocked_shortcuts: do not train controllers in M1198
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: shared seeds budgets env splits and eval metrics are fixed
repair and failure rules are fixed
next pilot run or implementation milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1198 designs comparison controls but does not test history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1198 may define evaluation windows but does not evaluate temporal evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a fair pilot cannot be designed without unequal tuning or private holdout, keep comparison blocked and route to process repair.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A fair public comparison pilot can be designed for L0/L1/L2/L3 profiles without using smoke metrics as performance evidence or tuning profiles unequally.
success_criteria: profile set, seeds, training budget, eval budget, metrics, artifacts, failure rules, and claim scope are fixed
smoke metrics are explicitly excluded as performance evidence
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input contract change occurs
next run or implementation milestone is selected
failure_criteria: pilot uses unequal budgets or per-profile tuning
M1197 smoke metrics are used as comparison evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced

commands.name: design_fair_comparison_pilot
commands.command: write fair comparison pilot design without running training

decision_rule: M1198 passes if it pre-registers a fair comparison pilot and keeps all performance claims blocked.
